engagement.title: RFID + MOVE MEDICAL Value Assessment
engagement.pain: BD Peripheral Intervention loses item-level visibility of lot-controlled, expiry-dated product once it leaves the line — driving field expiry scrap, consignment write-offs, audit and reconciliation labor across 2,100 accounts, GDC claims and discrepancies, and recall scope. RFID item-level visibility with MOVE MEDICAL as the software layer addresses all five from one data foundation.
